 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Jonathan Burkardt certainly cannot be accused of a poor scoring record. The Eintracht striker already has nine goals and four assists across all competitions this season.
 That tally, however, is not enough to earn him a place in the Germany squad. Although Burkardt was included in the expanded 44-man squad, Jürgen Klopp left him out of the final selection for the upcoming clashes with Serbia and the Netherlands.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement But the 26-year-old is not letting that get him down. He has just put his side 1-0 up against SC Paderborn with a classic centre-forward's finish.
 A clear message to the Germany coach: Don't count me out just yet!
